images.caption: This picture was scanned from a personal set of cards that belonged to my family depicting scenes of the Greek War of Independence, which consist on a series of portraits about the revolution heroes as well as main events such as major battles etc that are present on the Hellenic Parliament main halls. This card dates from 1929 and is a part of my personal kit of the main popular engravings of the epoque called "laiki gravoura".
